page.overview:
Who is Lindbergh?

Lindbergh, or "Lind" for short, is a cat mink and the commander of the Revolutionary Army's South Army.

Lindbergh is a short cat mink, standing about half as tall as Belo Betty. He has somewhat dark-cyan colored hair, white whiskers, a pink nose and cream-colored fur.

He wears a brown buttoned shirt, white pants, dark-brown boots, and an open buttoned amber coat. He also wears goggles over his eyes that have light-blue lenses, a amber top hat with side rims are curved upward, and another set of goggles that have orange lenses wrapped around it, and a jetpack on his back, which also carries his weapons.

Lindbergh seems to greatly enjoy combat, as he was excited to hear about the Revolutionary Army's upcoming fight against the World Nobles. He likes to test his new weapons out in battle and was annoyed when Morley started attacking first.
